    • addNamed

      public CodeBlock.Builder addNamed(String format, Map<String,?> arguments)
      Adds code whose placeholders name their arguments, as in $type:T or $count:L. Names start with a lower-case letter, followed by letters, digits and underscores. Arguments the format does not use are ignored. 
      builder.addNamed("$list:T<$item:T> $name:N = new $array:T<>()", Map.of(
        "list", List.class, "item", String.class, "name", "names", "array", ArrayList.class));
      Parameters:
      format - the code, with named placeholders
      arguments - the arguments, by name
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a name is not valid, a placeholder has no argument, or the format has a placeholder without a name
